validation_case.given: a decision implemented in several private copies, gated only through the default configuration
validation_case.when: the copies are collapsed onto one owner
validation_case.then: the regression that proves the collapse exercises the override branch where the copies disagreed, not only the default branch

content.title: Cover a collapsed duplicated decision on its override branch
content.context: Four private copies of one path-resolution decision agreed on the default branch and disagreed when an environment variable overrode the target root, so every gate stayed green while init status and init sync-hooks pointed at different places.
content.guidance: When collapsing a duplicated decision onto its owner, put the regression on the branch the old gate never exercised (for example an environment-variable override), not only on the default branch where the copies already agreed.
content.why_it_works: Duplicates drift on the branches no gate exercises, because agreement on the covered branch is continuously proved and everywhere else only assumed.
content.when_to_apply: Use when a refactor removes several private implementations of one decision in favour of a single owner.
content.when_not_to_apply: Do not require branch-level coverage of every code path, or when the decision already has one implementation.
content.verification: Run vendor/bin/phpunit --filter HostAssetPathOwnershipTest. Corroborating repository evidence: PR #612 made ManagedAssetTargetCatalog the sync-path owner and added regressions on the CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR / CLAUDE_AGENTS_DIR override branches; it predates this note, so it corroborates the pattern but does not show the note changed that decision.
failed_approaches: Asserting the collapse only through the default target root, where all copies already matched.
